_comment: Shapes for tests/unit/casting/test_free_cast_exile_instead.py. t_fcei_gearhulk is Torrential Gearhulk's trigger on a {U} 1/1: a free cast of target instant card from your graveyard, exiled instead of graveyarded. t_fcei_impulse is Impulsivity's: target instant or sorcery card from any graveyard. t_fcei_insight is an instant that asks nothing.

cards.name: Test Torrent Gearhulk
cards.oracle_text: When this creature enters, you may cast target instant card from your graveyard without paying its mana cost. If that spell would be put into your graveyard, exile it instead.

abilities.text: When this creature enters, you may cast target instant card from your graveyard without paying its mana cost. If that spell would be put into your graveyard, exile it instead.
